listed_sector_signals.signal: The case study validating the framework is an Indian steel re-rolling mill (SRRM), chosen as the empirical contextual domain
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The Indian Steel re-rolling mill (SRRM) sector was chosen as the contextual domain for the 
implementation of EEM framework.
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

listed_sector_signals.signal: SRRM identified as a segment of secondary steel producers contributing to total steel production
listed_sector_signals.quote:
SRMM is a crucial segment of the secondary steel 
producers (primary producers are Integrated Steel Producers or ISPs), which make up 60% of 
the long steel products and 30% of total steel production (UNDP, 2015).
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

listed_sector_signals.signal: Steel mill process: reheating furnace (pulverized coal) plus rolling mill, heating steel stock and rolling it through successive rollers
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The coal was used to heat the steel stock to required temperature 
(~1,200-1,2500C) in the reheating furnace. The heated steel was then rolled down through 
successive rollers driven by electric motors.
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

listed_sector_signals.signal: Reheating furnace explicitly described as a continuous pusher-type furnace producing large volume at regular intervals
listed_sector_signals.quote:
It was a continuous pusher 
type of furnace for producing large volume of output at regular intervals.
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

listed_sector_signals.signal: Prior-work reference to energy optimization in a paper mill's paper machines (mentioned only)
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The author illustrated the role of EnMS in the optimization of vacuum distribution and 
steam consumption in the paper machines of a small-sized paper mill.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Future-application suggestion naming cement and pulp & paper as other energy-intensive sectors (mentioned only, not applied)
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Future research should aim at the broader application of the 
framework in other energy-intensive industrial sectors, including cement, textiles and pulp & 
paper, to understand the impact of contextual changes on the application of the model.

one_line: The paper proposes an Energy Efficiency Maturity assessment framework for energy-intensive SMEs and validates it empirically in an Indian steel re-rolling mill (continuous pusher-type reheating furnace plus rolling mill), implementing measured EE projects such as a waste-heat-recovery upgrade and variable-frequency drives.
